newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Sony says intends to expand in east/central Europe.
newsitem.headline: Sony says intends to expand in east/central Europe.

text.p: Sony, which at present has only two manufacturing plants in Eastern Europe, intends to expand manufacturing in the region, company president Nobuyuki Idei said on Thursday.
"We have a strong intention to expand our manufacturing in East and Central Europe." Idei said at a meeting for Sony suppliers in Hungary.
Idei did not announce any specific plans for expansion by Sony, which now has manufacturing plants in Hungary and Slovakia.

Jakob Schmuckli, director of Sony Corporation and Chairman of Sony Europa Gmbh, said Sony was still in the initial stages with its 30 million German mark home audio plant in Godollo, Hungary, but planned to expand it soon from its current 300 workers to 600 or more.
Asked whether the quality of products at the plant was what Sony desired, Schmuckli said: "It is a bit early to tell.
"It depends on the management and the workers at the plant -- if they work well they have the best chance...to move it up" and expand the facility, Schmukli said.
